verdict.rationale: The only evidence of action-item extraction into a tracker is an API use case (docs-53). That is a developer building block for constructing the workflow, not a built-in feature. Nothing documents that Granola's own enhanced notes extract action items with owners or collect them in a trackable place. A PM's community report (comm-7) describes action items slipping through and building their own kanban app as a workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
